fields.title-post: Why we chose OpenIT Solutions to enrich the Innovorder ecosystem
fields.rt-blog-html:
At Innovorder, our mission is simple: to reinvent catering, whether commercial, collective or corporate, to make it smoother, more connected and more sustainable.

To achieve this goal, we have chosen to build an open ecosystem, capable of integrating the most innovative solutions on the market. With this in mind, we have chosen to collaborate with OpenIT Solutions, one of the pioneers of connected fridges.

‍

Why OpenIT Solutions?

We've met a lot of players in foodtech and connected catering. What convinced us about OpenIT was their ability to combine :

  • A vision aligned with our own: offering a simple, accessible experience for diners, while simplifying life for operators.
  • Continuous innovation: RFID, AI, cameras, connected freezers... they're constantly pushing back the boundaries of technology.
  • Local, sustainable roots: their fridges are 100% made in France, assembled in the Vendée region, with partners located less than 75 km away.

In choosing OpenIT, we opted for a reliable, eco-responsible and forward-looking partner.

‍

Natural integration into our platform

We have designed our platform as an open hub, capable of easily connecting the best solutions on the market.

With OpenIT, integration was seamless thanks to their APIs. In concrete terms, this means that :

Diners can pay using the same means they already use on our other solutions (company badge, bank card, meal vouchers).

Operators benefit from centralized, harmonized management, directly in their Innovorder environment.

And best of all: no additional friction for users, no application to download.

‍

What's in it for diners and operators?

For employees, an OpenIT Solutions connected fridge isn't just a snack dispenser. It's a catering outlet available 24/7, offering balanced meals designed by nutritionists and adapted to all work rhythms.

For site managers, it's a tool that can be controlled and optimized via our common platform, facilitating logistics, reducing waste and improving profitability.

‍

Our vision: aggregating the best of the market

We are convinced that no single player can meet the diverse needs of the foodservice industry. Our role at Innovorder is to bring together the best solutions on the market - like OpenIT - to build a complete, fluid and sustainable ecosystem.

By choosing OpenIT, we are taking a further step towards this vision: to offer diners an ever simpler and higher quality experience, and to give operators the tools to manage their catering outlets with peace of mind.
